analysis.overall: You spent an impressive 92% of your day in range despite a couple of quick glucose swings. A brief evening low and a late-afternoon bump were both handled promptly without throwing off the rest of your day.

events.title: Late afternoon rise
events.description: Glucose briefly climbed to 201 mg/dL following a meal and extra corrections, but settled back into target within an hour.

events.title: Evening low after dinner
events.description: Bolusing for 50g of carbs while sitting at 75 mg/dL caused insulin to hit before the food absorbed, dropping glucose down to 53 mg/dL before carb corrections brought it back up.

events.title: Overnight stabilization
events.description: Small automated corrections managed a slight rise up to 140 mg/dL, gently leveling you off in target for the rest of the night.

events.title: Late morning meal response
events.description: Eating brought levels up to a peak of 176 mg/dL, but your meal bolus brought you back down smoothly to around 100 mg/dL by lunchtime.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: When starting a meal with glucose sitting in the 70s, giving carbs a slight head start before bolusing can help prevent early dips.
